description: Twenty frozen real-word and short-phrase stress cases, led by the detached P.S./Did island and both Collection 14 vertical top notes.

policy.cleanup: Human-reviewed component ownership from one fixed extraction per scale. Tiny ambiguous texture retained in the hardest faded cases; outcomes are not accuracy estimates.
policy.evaluation: All cases are development stress cases. Algorithm failures are retained and the suite is not a held-out benchmark.
policy.parameter_selection: Two profiles frozen by observable source scale/orientation before envelope replay; no per-case bridge, padding, threshold, or smoothing overrides.
